description: The failure limit of a webhook ACK (PORT4, Daniel 08/11): the seconds the ingress may take to answer Origin's webhook, a cold start included. It is an acceptance criterion, not a timeout setting: it cuts nothing, and the 10 s Origin gives is not changed. Any single delivery over it is a failure (over_limit in the ingress log line, listed by scripts/medir), never a percentile. The stack hands it to the ingress as TOWER_INGRESS_ACK_LIMIT_S.
